_comment: IMP-179: versioned default framework policy. A deterministic PreToolUse command hook denies hand Write/Edit of governed Ignite Sentinel artifacts (gaps.md, requirements.md, project-brief.md, 03_specs/*.md, 04_backlog/*.md: the list in sentinel/governed_artifacts.py, IMP-343); regenerate them through the owning command the denial names (/gaps or /resolve-gaps, /ingest, /brief, /specs, /backlog). This is tier 1 (works in any Claude Code version). The deep, opt-in ignite-verifier (tier 3, PostToolUse) is enabled separately via .claude/settings.local.json — see .claude/hooks/README.md. The BA who needs a deliberate bypass has the CLI. IMP-313: the hook starts Python through .claude/hooks/python.sh (the plugin's shim, generated by python -m sentinel.adapters), never a bare python.
